validation_rules: root request payload must be an object
language must be id or en
CV analysis inputVersion must be cv-analyzer-v1
candidate reranking schemaVersion must be model-core-candidate-reranking-request-v1
profile payload must include sanitized CV/profile text or extracted signals
jobCandidates must contain at least one candidate and no duplicate jobId values
candidate scoring inputs are model-owned and must be present
backend hydration metadata is accepted only inside backendMetadata
top-level backend hydration fields such as title/companyName are rejected
ranking policy must require backend candidate IDs and deduplication

openrouter_boundary.note: OpenRouter remains wrapper-owned prose support only; request schemas do not require external GenAI.
